title: Collecting Mobile Wallet Resend Charges by Funding Method
content:
Finance collections note for **Mobile Wallet** resend charges: once the resend charge figure has been rounded to the cent, how the transfer was paid sets how that figure is collected.

| How the transfer was paid | How the rounded resend charge figure is collected |
|---|---|
| by credit card (a card funding fee entry stands on the transfer's ledger) | raised by the tier's credit-card funding fee percentage, that is multiplied by one plus that percentage over 100, and rounded half up to the cent |
| by pay-by-bank (the transfer's funding method is pay-by-bank) | the tier's pay-by-bank fee discount is taken off, never below 0.00 |
| by debit card, ACH debit or wire | collected as it stands |

The credit-card line is read from the ledger: a transfer with a card funding fee entry is treated as paid by credit card.

## Worked figures (hypothetical, on a tier whose credit-card funding fee is 3.00 percent and whose pay-by-bank discount is 1.00)

| Funding | Rounded resend charge figure | Collected |
|---|---|---|
| credit card | 2.39 | 2.39 multiplied by 1.03 is 2.4617, rounded to 2.46 |
| pay-by-bank | 2.39 | 2.39 less 1.00 is 1.39 |
| pay-by-bank | 0.80 | 0.80 less 1.00 would be below 0.00, so 0.00 |
| debit card | 2.39 | 2.39 |
